note: Set P is four takes on one nacreous/pearl cloud at dusk in winter, with the same unseen or no-one-expects angle recurring, so it reads as one idea reworded. Set Q is four takes on one lenticular cloud over a ridge in wind, spread across autumn, midwinter, first snow and a pearl-to-gray dusk, but Q2 and Q3 are near-duplicates of each other.
